description:
Schedule and publish posts to 21 social platforms from ChatGPT: LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Mastodon, Discord, Telegram, Slack, WordPress, Dev.to, Medium and more. Ask what's scheduled this week, check a draft against each platform's limits before it goes out, and read likes and comments back per post.

If you sell online, you can also connect your own Stripe (or Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Shopify, Paddle, Polar, Dodo Payments or Whop) and ask which specific posts made money, matched sale by sale.

Requires a seenpaid account. Instagram and Facebook currently work only for the app owner while Meta review is pending, X needs your own X API credentials, and TikTok sends videos to your drafts.

defaultPrompt: What's scheduled this week, and is anything missing a link?
Schedule this post to LinkedIn and Bluesky for 9am tomorrow
Which of my posts made the most money this month?
